During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Nefarid]] led an Imperial force in an '''attack''' upon the [[Mensaav Military Laboratory]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in order to capture the [[Death Mark laser]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] rallied to the lab's defense and drove back the Imperials, forcing Nefarid to retreat and summon reinforcements in the form of Alderaan's native [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] to overrun the lab.
